title: genista europaea
intro: Genista europaea, commonly known as the European broom or Scotch broom, is a flowering plant in the legume family (Fabaceae). This perennial shrub has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Genista europaea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include stimulating the immune system, reducing the risk of chronic diseases, and promoting wound healing.
